title: CellMSA: Context Modeling for Single-Cell Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.38908v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Single-cell transcriptomics enables profiling of cellular states at unprecedented resolution, but its high dimensionality, sparsity, and technical batch effects pose significant challenges for representation learning. Existing single-cell foundation models typically encode each cell independently or only model cells from the same batch for denoising, thereby underutilizing the rich relational information across batches and cell types to model gene expression patterns. We argue that single-cell models can benefit from more informative cell-context modeling. By comparing consistency and variation across cells, models can capture fine-grained gene-gene dependencies associated with cell states, which are essential for learning high-quality representations. translated_title: CellMSA：面向单细胞表征学习的上下文建模
translated_abstract: 单细胞转录组学能够以前所未有的分辨率剖析细胞状态，但其高维性、稀疏性以及技术批次效应给表征学习带来了重大挑战。现有的单细胞基础模型通常对每个细胞进行独立编码，或仅对同一批次内的细胞进行建模以实现去噪，因而未能充分利用跨批次、跨细胞类型的丰富关系信息来建模基因表达模式。我们认为，单细胞模型可以从更具信息量的细胞上下文建模中获益：通过比较细胞间的一致性与差异性，模型能够捕捉与细胞状态相关的细粒度基因-基因依赖关系，这对于学习高质量表征至关重要。受蛋白质建模中多序列比对（MSA）上下文应用的启发，我们提出了CellMSA，一个引入了MSA启发的（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CellMSA，受蛋白质建模中多序列比对（MSA）的启发，通过跨批次、跨细胞类型的细胞上下文建模来捕捉与细胞状态相关的细粒度基因-基因依赖关系，从而提升单细胞表征学习的质量。
en_tdlr: CellMSA is a single-cell representation learning framework inspired by multiple sequence alignment (MSA) context in protein modeling, which leverages informative cell-context modeling across batches and cell types to capture fine-grained gene-gene dependencies for learning high-quality cell representations.
